name: Crown
purpose: Ends the home screen: the crown, which grows and fades in as the user scrolls to the end, so they can tell there is nothing more below it.

origin.notes: ScrollBottomIndicatorView, the last thing in HomeContentView: the crownLogo image, 40pt square, centred, with 30pt below it, 28pt below the last widget. Its scale and opacity are both how much of those 70pt is in view, from 0 to 1. Android's HomeScreen draws the crown 38dp tall, 24dp below the last widget and 64dp above the end, and scales it in from half its size over 300ms once it comes into view, rather than with the scroll. This draws the iOS one.

rules: Use it only on the home screen, as the app does.
Put it last in the <govuk-app-screen>, after the last widget and before the tab bar. It grows over the last 70pt of the screen's scroll, so anything after it would leave it part grown.
It is decorative, so assistive technology skips it. Don't give it a label.

avoid.instead: Leave it out: other screens end with their last section.

avoid.when: For the GOV.UK wordmark at the top of Home

ios.symbol: HomeContentView, its spacing below the widgets

android.symbol: HomeScreen, its crown and the space below it

references.description: The end of the home screen, scrolled to the end, in light mode

examples.name: At the end of the home screen
examples.html:
<govuk-app-screen>
  <govuk-app-text align="center">Tell us what you think about the app</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-button variant="grouped-secondary">Give feedback</govuk-app-button>
  <govuk-app-crown></govuk-app-crown>
</govuk-app-screen>
